players.product: AI-Native Cloud: inference cloud (Inference Engine, serverless inference) and GPU Droplets on NVIDIA HGX and AMD Instinct GPUs, integrated with its Core Cloud

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q backlog and customer mix: of the $893,828 thousand of remaining performance obligations at June 30, 2026 (weighted-average life 3.7 years), DigitalOcean expects to recognize $365,901 thousand as revenue over the next 12 months. Customers spending above $1M generated $64,720 thousand, 23% of Q2 2026 revenue (9% a year earlier); their count rose to 45 from 26. ARR was $1,125 million (from $875 million) and AI customer ARR $234 million (from $75 million). Q2 revenue growth was driven by a 45% increase in revenue from Digital Native Enterprise customers, including its expanding AI customer base.
quarterly_data.figure: $365,901 thousand of RPO to be recognized in the next 12 months; $1M+ customers 23% of Q2 revenue (45 customers); ARR $1,125 million

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q data-center expansion costs: H1 2026 cost of revenue rose primarily due to data center expansions - $32.8 million higher depreciation and amortization related to data center infrastructure additions, $21.4 million higher co-location costs and $6.5 million higher ancillary equipment costs. Gross profit fell to 56% from 61%, which DigitalOcean attributes to costs for data center expansions incurred in advance of the ramp in revenue from new data centers. H1 capital expenditures for property and equipment were $81,576 thousand, plus $51,544 thousand of cash payments for equipment acquired under financing arrangements. Property and equipment, net rose to $1,049,332 thousand from $589,094 thousand at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 gross margin 56% (61% a year earlier); H1 capex $81,576 thousand plus $51,544 thousand equipment under financing arrangements
